header.ga4_note: GA4 2026-10-27 is provisional; GA4 keeps processing for up to two days.

health_check.evidence: GA4 sessions on 2026-10-27: 1,196 against a same-weekday baseline of 1,086; key events 36 against 30.
Every ad account spent on 2026-10-27: Google Ads $559 (baseline $259), Meta $213 (baseline $214), LinkedIn Ads $91 (baseline $84), TikTok Ads $62 (baseline $40).

Google Ads spent $558.85 on 2026-10-27, 2.2x its same-weekday baseline of $258.58 ($300.27 more). Search | Appointment reminders spent $344.00 against its own baseline of $46.70. Google Ads spent $247.48 on 2026-10-26, inside its normal level, so the jump started on 2026-10-27. The other accounts pass: Meta 0.99x its baseline; LinkedIn Ads 1.09x its baseline; TikTok Ads 1.55x its baseline, but only $22.06 above it, under the $25 a warning needs.
Ad clicks on 2026-10-27: 569. GA4 paid sessions (Paid Search 217, Paid Social 245): 462, 81.2% of the clicks, above 50%.

GA4, Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads all returned rows for 2026-10-27. Search Console's latest date is 2026-10-25, 3 days before today, inside the 4-day limit, so organic clicks use that day. GA4 2026-10-27 is provisional (said in the status line).
685 of 1,196 sessions engaged on 2026-10-27 (57.3%), against 3,653 of 6,400 (57.1%) over the 7 days before, well above a third of it.
GA4 paid-channel sessions on 2026-10-27: 462, and the ad accounts spent $925.21, so paid visits have spend behind them.

daily_kpis.why: baseline clears its floor, moved 40% or more, and is outside the range of the four same weekdays
daily_kpis.explained_by: Google Ads Search | Appointment reminders: $344.00 against its own baseline of $46.70 (see H3).

weekly_scan.explained_by: Prospecting | Salon owners, 16 fewer sign-ups than the week before
Fall launch | Deposits, $77 more than the week before (a new campaign, first day with impressions 2026-10-23, so all of it is new)
Fall launch | Deposits, 156 more clicks than the week before (a new campaign, first day with impressions 2026-10-23, so all of it is new)

roas_cpa_alert.trigger: a fall of 25% or more (no target given)
a rise of 30% or more (no target given)
roas_cpa_alert.explained_by: Sign-ups fell from 69 to 49 while spend moved -3.1%; most of the drop is Prospecting | Salon owners, 16 fewer sign-ups than the week before.

roas_cpa_alert.why: 4 conversions in the last 7 days and 4 in the 7 before; both weeks need 5 or more. Website conversions and lead-form leads are counted together.
No conversion and no conversion value is tracked on this account, so there is no ROAS or CPA to watch.
roas_cpa_alert.fix: Set up the sign-up as a conversion event in TikTok Ads Manager (and pass a value if you can) before judging these campaigns on results.

blended_roas.why: GA4 totalRevenue is $0 in the window (revenue isn't sent to GA4), so no blended ROAS.

body.text:
*Example Booking Software daily digest: Tue 27 Oct 2026 (USD)*
1 critical, 1 warning. GA4 numbers for 27 Oct are provisional.
• Ad spend: $925 (baseline $600, +54.3%) (flagged)
• Results (GA4 key events): 36 (baseline 30, +18.0%)
• Cost per result: $26 (baseline $20, +30.1%)
• Sessions: 1,196 (baseline 1,086, +10.1%)
• Organic clicks: 208 on Sun 25 Oct 2026 (baseline 217, -4.1%)
• ROAS/CPA: Google Ads ROAS 3.81 on the last 7 days (-16.4%, inside the 25% alert line). LinkedIn has too few conversions to judge. TikTok isn't armed: no conversion is tracked.
*Findings*
• CRITICAL Google Ads spent $559 against a baseline of $259 (2.2x). Search | Appointment reminders alone spent $344 (usually $47). Separate alert below.
• Meta cost per sign-up is $27 on the last 7 days against $20 the 7 before (+36.4%). Sign-ups fell from 69 to 49 on flat spend, mostly in Prospecting | Salon owners.
_Sources: active Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, GA4, Search Console. Idle: none. Broken: none. Not covered: Klaviyo, organic social._
